notes: Synthetic documentation inputs only; no database, project or provider access. Uppercase host places are a closed registry, never process environment.
Four proposed ASCII-only semantic byte vectors use unchanged canonical-json.v1. Not replacements for S6 codec vectors or complete final CXT2 storage schemas.
CXT2 must freeze final package/DDL/API field shapes; updating proposed semantic shapes requires new named vectors, never silently editing established hashes.

fenced_future.expected: same bounded AST when supported; otherwise unsupported-container; never shell execution

secret_requirement.expected: no SecretRef ID, raw value or secret-derived digest serialized; shared caching disabled

proposal.expected: application not permitted until successful Run and explicit authorized CAS command

asset_metadata.expected: only with explicit captured single-asset binding; no implicit Gallery selection
